lines.text: Too tired from too much work.
After exams, I felt totally burned out.

data.mean: Too tired from too much work.
data.define: Used when you are worn out after working or studying too long.

example.text: After exams, I felt totally burned out.

misuse.text: Don't say 'burned out' after one busy day.

data.l1_hook: Terlalu banyak kerja. Aku sudah 'burned out'!
data.l1_ex: Setelah ujian, aku merasa benar-benar 'burned out'.

native.tip: “burned out” = kelelahan; kelelahan total; burnout. Contoh: “After exams, I felt totally burned out.”
native.caption:
Apa arti “burned out”?

Contoh: “After exams, I felt totally burned out.” (Setelah ujian, aku merasa benar-benar 'burned out'.)
